Act") for compensation on account of the fatal injuries sustained by deceased Nisar Ahamad S/o Late Sh. Yameen in a road vehicular accident which took place on 28.02.2021 at about 6:00 PM near brick Bhatta, Village Kedwa, Sarai-Baraut Road, Baghpat, UP.

Brief facts of the case as set out in the petition are as follows:-
2.2
On 28.02.2021, Sh. Nisar Ahamad (hereinafter referred as "deceased) along with one Noor Mohd. was returning from Baraut on a motorcycle bearing registration No. UP15AA6311.
The motorcycle was being driven by Noor Mohd., at a normal speed & following the traffic rules.
Both the occupants were wearing helmets.

At about 6:00 PM,
when they reached near Brick Bhatta, Village Kedwa, Sarai-Baraut Road, Baghpat, UP, a Truck bearing registration No.HR55S4557 (hereinafter referred as "Offending Vehicle") which was being driven by its driver at very high speed, in rash and negligent manner and without following the traffic rules came from back side and hit the vehicle of the deceased with a great force.
Consequently, the deceased fell down and the offending vehicle ran over the deceased.
The deceased expired on the spot.
Post Mortem of the deceased was conducted at Govt. Hospital, Baghpat.

The deceased was 48 years of age at the time of accident and was working as Confectioner in Shahadara,
Delhi and earning Rs.20,000/- per month.
FIR No. 057/2021 under Section 279/427/304A IPC PS Singhawali Ahir Baghpat, UP was registered against respondent no.1.

It is averred that the respondent no.01 being driver, respondent no.02 being owner and respondent no.03 being the insurer of offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner(s).
